newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Three die in Nigerian bus price riot.
newsitem.headline: Three die in Nigerian bus price riot.

text.p: Three people died and many more were injured in the southwest Nigerian town of Ilaro during weekend riots which erupted when students protested against an increase in bus fares, residents said on Monday.
"Two drivers died and one student," said one resident in the town by telephone. "Several buildings were burned, and lots of vehicles too."
Another resident said the local government had imposed a dawn-to-dusk curfew and closed the local college.
The trouble began on Friday when bus drivers raised the price for the 55 km (35 mile) journey to the commercial capital Lagos to 150 naira ($1.80) from 80 naira ($0.95) and students refused to pay.

Transport prices have been forced higher in many parts of Nigeria by local shortages of petrol, which persist in spite of the fact that military authorities have given the go ahead for imports of fuel to Africa's biggest crude oil producer.
